kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتعارك (form VI)
# نَتَعَارَكُ (nataʕāraku) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.ku/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
# نَتَعَارَكَ (nataʕāraka) /na.ta.ʕaː.ra.ka/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
# نَتَعَارَكْ (nataʕārak) /na.ta.ʕaː.rak/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَعَارَكَ (taʕāraka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
